tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Details of EMD Amount and Payment Details Submitted via e-Procurement

The Human Resource organization must be a registered entity registration must be evidenced by a certificate issued under the Societies Registration Act, the Companies Act, or the Co-operative Societies Act.(Submission of an ISO certificate alone will not be considered valid.)

The registration certificate under the EPF Act, along with copies of the relevant challans evidencing the payment of EPF contributions for the years 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25, must be attached. Additionally, certified copies of challans confirming the payment of Rs. 2 crore for the year 2024-25 must be enclosed. (No exemptions will be granted for the non-payment of the Rs. 2 crore amount, regardless of the reason cited.)

The registration certificate under the ESI Act and certified copies of bank/online challans evidencing the payment of Rs. 25 lakh for the year 2024-25 must be attached. (No exemption from the payment of Rs. 25 lakh shall be granted on any other grounds.)

Copies of the relevant challans evidencing the payment of a minimum of Rs. 10 crore towards Goods and Services Tax (GST) for the year 2024-25 must be attached. (No exemptions will be granted for the non-payment of the Rs. 10 crore amount, regardless of the reason cited.)

Submit a copy of the Income Tax Return Form-5 regarding the payment of income tax for the financial years 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25 to the Income Tax Department. (This must be in the name of the organization.)

The annual turnover for the years 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25 must be at least Rs. 18 crore for each year. A confirmation letter regarding this, obtained from a Chartered Accountant (CA), must be submitted.
The Professional Tax Department registration certificate must be submitted.

A Professional Tax Clearance Certificate for the years 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25, along with a copy of the '9A' challan evidencing the monthly payment of professional tax for the year 2024-25, must be submitted.

The tenderer must possess experience in providing as a human resource agency to government/semi-government and government-recognized organizations an average of 50 stenographers, 250 typists/data entry assistants, and Group-'D' staff per year during the years 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25 and You must submit the number of stenographers provided for each respective year, along with experience certificates obtained from government, semi-government, or government-recognized organizations. (Please attach documents only in relation to the number of personnel provided as mentioned above.)

Elected public representatives, entities that have been blacklisted, or entities against whom a legal case has been registered are not permitted to participate in the tender. Bidders must submit an affidavit executed on a Rs. 100 stamp paper and attested by a Notary confirming that they are not blacklisted, are not elected public representatives, and that no legal case has been registered against their entity. (This affidavit must bear a date subsequent to the date of issuance of this notification.)

A certificate obtained from the competent authority in Form 'C', regarding registration under the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, must be submitted this certificate must be valid for the current year.

A document containing the license/permission obtained from the competent authority of the Municipal Corporation, City Municipal Council, Town Panchayat, or Municipal Council regarding the establishment of the agency.

The agency must have a local office. It is required to submit the necessary documentation regarding this if an office does not currently exist, the agency must submit an undertaking to open one should its tender be accepted.
The original documents corresponding to all the records mentioned above must be produced on the date specified by the authority inviting the tender.

Original copies of all the aforementioned documents must be uploaded to the e-portal. The agency shall be held responsible if the documents are not uploaded or if they are not clearly visible furthermore, any documents submitted subsequently will not be accepted, On the final date prescribed for the submission of tenders, provide a set of photocopies of all documents uploaded to the eportal. These copies must be attested by a Notary Public and each page must be numbered by hand. Place these documents in a sealed envelope, and indicate the total number of pages contained within on the exterior of the envelope. (Note No additional documents other than those already uploaded to the eportal may be attached any such additional documents will not be taken into consideration.) Hard copies of the uploaded documents must be submitted directly to the tendering authority at the Directorate of Prosecutions and Government Litigation, K.H.B. Complex, 6th Floor, Kaveri Bhavan, Kempegowda Road, Bengaluru, and an acknowledgment must be obtained. (The deadline for submission is 5:00 PM on 07-12-2026).
